titulo: Moved her book? Say exactly where you put it
caption:
Moved her book? Say exactly where you put it

Maya's book was on the table. Cella moves it to shelf two and leaves a note: shelf two, left side.

For whoever says where they put it.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a dining room. At the top, the words: Maya's book moved. Shelf 2, left. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left of a table with a red book on it, and a second small figure of another color stands to the right under a wall shelf with two boards numbered 1 and 2 and a few books. The words appear one line at a time: Maya's book, on the table. I move it to shelf 2 (the book arcs up and settles at the left end of the lower board). I write down where (a note appears on the table that says shelf 2, left side). Now she knows (the second figure looks at the note, its eyes go wide and then close in a smile, a star appears). The closing line: for whoever says where they put it. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella moved a book today. Somebody knows exactly where it went.
evolucion: Tres apuestas (junta-ene-s3, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. (c) Hora (apuesta 3a): tres Shorts a las 23:00Z contra tres a las 17:00Z; sin el si de N salen todos a las 17:00Z y el campo apuesta_hora de pieza.json dice cual es el brazo.
